by_sender_name_contains._comment: Cross-platform sender name substring matches. Case-insensitive. WARNING: display names are trivially spoofable — anyone can put your company's name in their handle to jump the triage queue. Never auto-trust on name alone; treat matches as a hint, verify identity (mutual contacts, official domain, known account) before acting on the message. Populate with your own company name in a PRIVATE local copy.
